class.name: SteamAchievement
class.brief_description: A read-only snapshot of an achievement and the signed-in player's unlock state.
class.description: Get snapshots from [method SteamStats.achievements] or [method SteamStats.achievement]. A snapshot remains readable after Steam stops. Read it again through [SteamStats] to observe a change.

method.name: get_api_name
method.description: Returns the app's published achievement identifier.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns the localized description copied from Steam, or an empty string if unavailable.

method.name: get_display_name
method.description: Returns the localized name copied from Steam, or [member api_name] as a string if unavailable.

method.name: get_unlocked_at_unix
method.description: Returns the unlock time in Unix seconds, or zero when no timestamp is available.

method.name: is_hidden
method.description: Returns whether Steam marks the achievement as hidden.

method.name: is_unlocked
method.description: Returns whether the signed-in player had unlocked this achievement at the time of the snapshot.

members.member: Stable Steamworks API name. Use it in lookups and stat drafts.
Localized Steamworks description. An empty string means Steam supplied no description. For a hidden locked entry, keep the description out of the player-facing achievement list.
Localized achievement name supplied by Steam. Uses [member api_name] as a string when Steam omits the name.
Whether the app marks the achievement as hidden. Defaults to [code]false[/code] when Steam omits the flag. Use it with [member unlocked] to decide whether to show its name and description.
Whether the signed-in player had unlocked the achievement at the time of the snapshot.
Unlock time as Unix seconds. Zero means the achievement is locked or Steam has no timestamp. Use [member unlocked] to determine the unlock state.
